scientific_note: All NORAD IDs, operators, orbit regimes, and sensor modalities reflect publicly documented mission profiles (ISRO, WMO OSCAR, ESA Copernicus, NASA/USGS, JAXA, CSA, CEOS EO Handbook). Unknown or mission-mode-dependent technical figures are stored as null rather than estimated.

51656.name: EOS-04
51656.mission_summary: ISRO C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Earth-observation satellite providing all-weather, day-and-night imagery for flood inundation mapping, agriculture, forestry, and soil moisture monitoring.

sensors.name: C-band SAR (5.35 GHz)
sensors.notes: Multi-mode SAR (Fine Resolution Stripmap to Coarse Resolution ScanSAR; resolution ranges from ~1 m high-res spotlight/stripmap modes to ~50 m wide swath).

active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Potential loss of sovereign cloud-penetrating radar passes over monsoon-flooded basins, delaying inundation extent maps under heavy cloud cover.
Reduced ability to map coastal flooding and wind-damaged terrain through dense cyclonic cloud cover.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Kharif/Rabi Crop Acreage & Soil Moisture Monitoring
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Intermittent gaps in cloud-free monsoon crop monitoring and soil-moisture analytics.

sources: WMO OSCAR Space Satellite Program: EOS-04

54361.name: EOS-06
54361.mission_summary: ISRO third-generation ocean observation satellite carrying Ocean Color Monitor (OCM-3), Sea Surface Temperature Monitor (SSTM), and Ku-band Scatterometer (OSCAT-3) for cyclone wind-vector forecasting and marine fisheries advisories.

sensors.name: OSCAT-3 Ku-band Scatterometer
sensors.notes: Measures ocean surface wind speed and direction for cyclone genesis and intensification tracking.

sensors.name: OCM-3 Ocean Color Monitor
sensors.notes: 13-band optical ocean color sensor supporting Potential Fishing Zones (PFZ) and algal bloom monitoring.

sensors.name: SSTM Sea Surface Temperature Monitor
sensors.notes: Two-band thermal infrared sea surface temperature sensor.

active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Potential reduction in domestic scatterometer ocean-wind assimilation for Bay of Bengal and Arabian Sea cyclone intensity forecasting.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Ocean State Forecasting & Potential Fishing Zone Advisories
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Degraded sea-surface temperature and ocean-color inputs for maritime and coastal livelihood advisories.

sources: WMO OSCAR Space Satellite Program: EOS-06

44804.name: Cartosat-3
44804.mission_summary: ISRO third-generation agile very-high-resolution optical imaging satellite for large-scale urban planning, infrastructure mapping, and post-disaster damage assessment.

sensors.name: Panchromatic High-Resolution Camera (PAN)
sensors.notes: Sub-meter panchromatic optical imaging; requires cloud-free daylight conditions.

sensors.name: 4-Band Multispectral Camera (MX)
sensors.notes: High-resolution VNIR multispectral imaging.

active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Loss of sovereign sub-meter optical imaging needed to assess collapsed structures, washed-out roads, and landslide scars after clear skies return.
Delays in high-resolution national mapping updates and coastal infrastructure monitoring.

41877.name: Resourcesat-2A
41877.mission_summary: ISRO multispectral optical remote sensing satellite carrying LISS-IV, LISS-III, and AWiFS sensors for land-use mapping, drought/crop monitoring, and clear-sky flood assessment.

sensors.name: LISS-IV / LISS-III / AWiFS Multispectral Suite
sensors.notes: Multi-tier optical suite: LISS-IV (~5.8 m, 70 km swath), LISS-III (~23.5 m, 141 km swath), AWiFS (~56 m, 740 km swath).

active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Reduced domestic medium-resolution optical time-series for national crop health and drought stress bulletins.
Fewer wide-swath optical passes to evaluate post-flood standing water and agricultural losses once clouds clear.

60454.name: EOS-08
60454.orbit_type: Circular Low Earth Orbit (~475 km, 37.4° inclination)
60454.mission_summary: ISRO microsatellite platform carrying Electro Optical Infrared (EOIR) payload for disaster/thermal monitoring, GNSS-Reflectometry (GNSS-R) for ocean wind & flood/soil moisture sensing, and SiC UV Dosimeter.

sensors.name: EOIR (Mid-Wave & Long-Wave IR Payload)
sensors.notes: Designed for day/night thermal imaging including wildfire, volcanic, and disaster environmental observation.

sensors.name: GNSS-R Reflectometry Payload
sensors.notes: Experimental ocean surface wind analysis, soil moisture assessment, and flood detection over Himalayan/inland regions.

active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Interruption to experimental day/night thermal-IR payload validation and hazard observation demos.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Experimental GNSS-R Soil Moisture & Flood Detection
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Loss of experimental GNSS-reflectometry hydrology datasets.

41752.name: INSAT-3DR
41752.mission_summary: ISRO geostationary meteorological satellite providing continuous weather imaging, atmospheric sounding, Data Relay Transponder (DRT), and Satellite Aided Search and Rescue (SAS&R) over the Indian subcontinent and Indian Ocean.

sensors.name: 6-Channel Imager & 19-Channel Sounder
sensors.notes: Continuous geostationary disk imaging (1 km visible, 4 km IR) and vertical atmospheric temperature/humidity profiling.

sensors.name: SAS&R & Data Relay Transponder
sensors.notes: Relays emergency distress beacons (COSPAS-SARSAT) and automated weather station telemetry.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Continuous Geostationary Cyclone & Severe Storm Nowcasting
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Reduced geostationary imaging redundancy over the Indian Ocean, impacting rapid-scan cyclone eye and convective storm monitoring.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: National Weather Forecasting & Monsoon Atmospheric Sounding
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Loss of half of India's dual-GEO meteorological observation continuity if paired assets are stressed.
Reduced geostationary distress-beacon relay capacity over the Indian Ocean search-and-rescue region.

58990.name: INSAT-3DS
58990.mission_summary: ISRO follow-on geostationary meteorological satellite funded by the Ministry of Earth Sciences to provide enhanced continuous cyclone tracking, atmospheric sounding, DRT, and SAS&R services.

sensors.name: 6-Channel Imager & 19-Channel Sounder
sensors.notes: Primary newest Indian geostationary meteorological imager/sounder supporting IMD operational forecasting.

sensors.name: SAS&R & Data Relay Transponder
sensors.notes: Distress alert relay and meteorological data collection platform transponder.

active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Potential service disruption to India's newest operational geostationary cyclone and thunderstorm nowcasting asset, forcing reliance on older INSAT-3DR.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Operational Atmospheric Sounding & Numerical Weather Assimilation
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Degraded real-time atmospheric profile assimilation for extreme precipitation and heatwave warnings.
Reduced emergency beacon detection coverage in GEO over the Indian Ocean region.

45026.name: GSAT-30
45026.mission_summary: ISRO high-power geostationary C-band and Ku-band communication satellite supporting VSAT networks, DTH, television uplinking, and emergency/disaster communications across India and surrounding regions.

sensors.name: C-band & Ku-band Communication Transponders
sensors.notes: Ku-band coverage over Indian mainland and islands; extended C-band coverage across Asia/Gulf/Australia.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: VSAT, Remote Island & Emergency Disaster Communications
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Potential outage or degradation of VSAT backhaul and emergency communications when terrestrial cellular/fiber networks fail during floods or cyclones.

52903.name: GSAT-24
52903.mission_summary: 24-Ku band geostationary communication satellite built by ISRO and operated by NewSpace India Limited (NSIL) for pan-India telecommunications and DTH broadcast.

sensors.name: 24-Ku Band Communication Payload
sensors.notes: Pan-India Ku-band coverage co-located near 83° E orbital slot.

active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Degraded Ku-band broadcast capacity and reduced orbital transponder reserve at 83° E.

56759.name: NVS-01
56759.mission_summary: First second-generation Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (NavIC) spacecraft featuring L1, L5, and S-band signals and an indigenous Rubidium atomic clock.

sensors.name: NavIC L1 / L5 / S-Band PNT Payload
sensors.notes: Provides regional Positioning, Navigation, Timing (PNT) and short-message maritime/disaster alert broadcasts over India and +1,500 km surrounding region.

active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Reduced NavIC constellation geometry and L1 civilian signal availability over India.
Potential disruption to one-way cyclone and high-wave warning broadcast redundancy for vessels at sea.

43286.name: IRNSS-1I
43286.mission_summary: First-generation NavIC regional navigation satellite operating in inclined geosynchronous orbit providing L5 and S-band positioning and timing over India.

sensors.name: NavIC L5 / S-Band PNT Payload
sensors.notes: L5 and S-band PNT signals (does not carry newer L1 band present on NVS-01).

active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Degraded NavIC Dilution of Precision (DOP) across the regional service footprint.

62701.name: Firefly-1
62701.mission_summary: Commercial hyperspectral imaging small satellite built by Indian space-tech startup Pixxel, capturing 135+ spectral bands for precision agriculture, water-quality assessment, and environmental monitoring.

sensors.name: Firefly Hyperspectral Imager (135+ VNIR/SWIR bands)
sensors.notes: High-resolution commercial hyperspectral camera; requires clear-sky daylight conditions.

active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Reduced revisit cadence for high-resolution commercial hyperspectral environmental monitoring and customer tasking.
Delayed narrow-band spectral crop-health analytics over tasked agricultural zones.

62710.name: Firefly-3
62710.mission_summary: Constellation peer to Firefly-1 in Pixxel's commercial hyperspectral imaging fleet, supporting global narrow-band environmental and crop health analytics.

sensors.name: Firefly Hyperspectral Imager (135+ bands)
sensors.notes: Identical hyperspectral sensor architecture to Firefly-1.

active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Reduced constellation revisit capacity for hyperspectral tasking.

58989.name: TIRSAT
58989.operator: University of Fukui / Japanese Space Consortium
58989.mission_summary: 3U university-linked experimental Earth-observation CubeSat demonstrating a miniaturized Linear Variable Band-Pass Filter (LVBPF) hyperspectral camera for agricultural and forestry research.

sensors.name: Miniaturized LVBPF Hyperspectral Camera
sensors.notes: Experimental 3U CubeSat optical/hyperspectral payload.

active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Potential interruption to academic hyperspectral calibration experiments (no operational emergency service dependency).

39634.name: Sentinel-1A
39634.mission_summary: ESA Copernicus C-band SAR satellite delivering free and open all-weather radar imagery globally for flood monitoring, land deformation, and maritime surveillance.

sensors.name: C-SAR (5.405 GHz)
sensors.notes: Interferometric Wide Swath (IW) primary mode (~5x20 m resolution, 250 km swath); open Copernicus data access.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Global Open-Access SAR Flood & Inundation Mapping
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Reduced open global C-band SAR pass frequency for emergency flood and landslide response.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: SAR Ocean Surface Wind & Coastal Flooding Support
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Fewer high-resolution coastal SAR passes during severe storms.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Global All-Weather Crop & Soil Moisture Time-Series
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Longer repeat intervals for radar-based agricultural monitoring.

62261.name: Sentinel-1C
62261.mission_summary: ESA Copernicus C-band SAR satellite restoring two-satellite Sentinel-1 constellation revisit cadence with added AIS maritime tracking.

sensors.name: C-SAR (5.405 GHz)
sensors.notes: Open Copernicus C-band SAR in 180-degree orbital phasing with Sentinel-1A.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Copernicus Open C-Band SAR Flood Mapping
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Loss of two-satellite Sentinel-1 6-day combined revisit cadence for global flood and deformation mapping.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: SAR + AIS Maritime Surveillance & Oil-Spill Detection
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Reduced radar-plus-AIS ship and spill monitoring coverage.

39766.name: ALOS-2
39766.mission_summary: JAXA L-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (PALSAR-2) satellite capable of penetrating dense vegetation canopies and cloud cover for flood, landslide, and crustal deformation assessment.

sensors.name: PALSAR-2 L-Band SAR (1.2 GHz)
sensors.notes: L-band wavelength penetrates forest canopies better than C-band; tasked via Sentinel Asia / International Charter during major disasters.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Canopy-Penetrating L-Band SAR Flood & Wetland Mapping
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Loss of specialized L-band radar capable of detecting standing water beneath dense tropical forest canopies.
Reduced high-coherence L-band InSAR capability over vegetated mountainous terrain.

44322.name: RCM-1
44322.mission_summary: C-band SAR satellite in Canada's three-satellite RADARSAT Constellation supporting maritime surveillance, disaster management, and ecosystem monitoring.

sensors.name: RCM C-Band SAR (5.405 GHz)
sensors.notes: Multi-mode C-band SAR; primary government access with International Charter support for major disasters.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: C-Band SAR Emergency Flood Support (Charter Eligible)
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Reduced three-satellite SAR revisit cadence for emergency disaster response.
Lower radar surveillance refresh rates over maritime zones.

sources: Canadian Space Agency RCM Technical Characteristics (asc-csa.gc.ca)

40697.name: Sentinel-2A
40697.mission_summary: ESA Copernicus 13-band optical multispectral satellite providing free, global 10 m–60 m imagery for land monitoring, agriculture, and clear-sky disaster mapping.

sensors.name: MultiSpectral Instrument (MSI, 13 bands)
sensors.notes: Open Copernicus optical data; cannot penetrate dense cloud cover during active storms.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Global Open Multispectral Crop & Vegetation Monitoring
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Reduced optical revisit cadence for global land and crop time-series.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Clear-Sky Post-Flood Surface Water & Damage Mapping
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Fewer clear-sky optical windows for post-event flood boundary verification.

42063.name: Sentinel-2B
42063.mission_summary: Twin Copernicus optical multispectral satellite operating in complementary phase with Sentinel-2A for 5-day combined global revisit.

sensors.name: MultiSpectral Instrument (MSI, 13 bands)
sensors.notes: Open Copernicus optical data; subject to cloud obscuration.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Global Open Multispectral Crop & Vegetation Monitoring
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Longer intervals between cloud-free optical land observations.
Reduced clear-sky optical verification passes.

49260.name: Landsat-9
49260.mission_summary: NASA/USGS Earth-observation satellite combining OLI-2 multispectral optical imaging (30 m) and TIRS-2 thermal infrared sensing (100 m) with open global data access.

sensors.name: OLI-2 Operational Land Imager
sensors.notes: 9-band multispectral (15 m panchromatic); open USGS archive.

sensors.name: TIRS-2 Thermal Infrared Sensor
sensors.notes: 2-band thermal infrared for land surface temperature, drought stress, and wildfire assessment.

active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Reduced open thermal-IR and multispectral land-surface continuity.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Thermal-IR Burn Scar & Heat Anomaly Mapping
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Longer repeat gap for calibrated thermal-IR surface mapping.

41836.name: Himawari-9
41836.mission_summary: JMA geostationary weather satellite carrying the 16-band Advanced Himawari Imager (AHI) providing 10-minute full-disk weather imaging across Asia-Pacific, with oblique coverage extending over the Bay of Bengal and Eastern India.

sensors.name: Advanced Himawari Imager (AHI, 16 bands)
sensors.notes: Full-disk every 10 minutes; viewing angle becomes oblique over Western India / Arabian Sea.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Asia-Pacific & Eastern Indian Ocean Cyclone Nowcasting
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Loss of primary 10-minute geostationary weather feed across East Asia and Western Pacific.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Rapid-Scan Convective Storm & Volcanic Ash Monitoring
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Degraded high-frequency storm and ash cloud monitoring across Asia-Pacific.

28912.name: Meteosat-9
28912.mission_summary: EUMETSAT geostationary meteorological satellite stationed for Indian Ocean Data Coverage (IODC), providing 15-minute SEVIRI weather imagery covering the Arabian Sea, Indian Ocean, and Indian subcontinent.

sensors.name: SEVIRI 12-Channel Imager
sensors.notes: 15-minute full-disk repeat over the Indian Ocean Data Coverage (IODC) footprint; does not replace INSAT SAS&R/DRT domestic transponders.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Indian Ocean Data Coverage (IODC) Cyclone & Monsoon Imaging
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Reduced geostationary weather coverage over the western Indian Ocean and Arabian Sea.
Loss of complementary 15-minute IODC geostationary imagery.

sources: EUMETSAT Meteosat Indian Ocean Data Coverage (eumetsat.int)

43013.name: NOAA-20
43013.mission_summary: NOAA/NASA polar-orbiting operational meteorological satellite carrying VIIRS, CrIS, and ATMS to feed global numerical weather prediction models, storm profiling, and nighttime flood/fire detection.

sensors.name: VIIRS (Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite)
sensors.notes: Wide-swath day/night visible and thermal IR imaging for fires, sea surface temp, and flood composites.

sensors.name: ATMS / CrIS Atmospheric Sounders
sensors.notes: Polar-orbiting microwave/IR atmospheric sounding (twice daily per location, NOT continuous geostationary monitoring).

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Global Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) Sounding Assimilation
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Degraded global atmospheric temperature/moisture sounding assimilation for 3-to-7-day storm track forecasts.

active_service_dependencies.service_name: Global Active Fire & Thermal Anomaly Detection
active_service_dependencies.disruption_consequence: Reduced twice-daily global 375 m active-fire detections.
